blob_count — 2D features op

• Data kinds: region → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "blob_count", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: count_obj (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Number of connected components in the region (HALCON count_obj).
